# Contributing to Velora

Velora currently targets Arch Linux. Keep changes focused, make optional
features configurable, and preserve existing user settings during migrations.

See the [development guide](../docs/development.md) for source layout, local
execution and validation commands. Write new technical documentation,
installer prompts and diagnostics in English.

Run the installer and updater regression tests before submitting changes to
maintenance tooling. For shell changes, also check the affected screens in a
running Hyprland session. Include the relevant validation in your pull request.

Preserve upstream attribution and third-party notices. Velora's original
contributions use GPLv3; see [LICENSE](../LICENSE) and [NOTICE](../NOTICE).
